validation_scope: Fresh targeted and full three package validation. Does not reuse wave5 checkpoint or claim a new whole-repository checkpoint.
runtime: pure Go; only new production three/segment.go; no new dependency, native binding, cgo, subprocess or fallback runtime

api.CylinderBetween: func CylinderBetween(start, end geom.Vec3, radius float64, radialSegments, heightSegments int) (*Mesh, error)
api.ArrowBetween: func ArrowBetween(start, end geom.Vec3, options ArrowOptions) (*Mesh, error)
api.geometry: Closed exterior mesh: cylinder side plus two caps; arrow shaft side plus conical side plus tail cap and annular downward shoulder, no internal overlapping caps. Exact copied hard-boundary positions; split outward normals and UVs.
api.ownership: Independent caller-owned mutable Mesh slices; endpoints/options copied by value, no retained input or cache; finish editing before concurrent render.

limits.detail_policy: minimum radial sagitta/axial step/annular gap >=32 ULPs at endpoint-plus-max-radius magnitude; final Mesh.Validate bounds output

api.unsupported: No short-arrow scaling/default options, head-only/equal-or-narrower head, per-part materials, bevels, boundary attachment or path frame transport. Least-aligned-axis roll may switch at ties. No full Manim parity claim.

reference.scope: Read-only source semantics: thickness radius, shaft shortened by height, conical tip at end; no matching default styling/topology or Manim render claim. Expected geometry and pixels use independent Go parameter/ray formulas, with no Manim runtime.

validation.staging: Production first authored under three/_segment; central runner plus Go overlay validated staged geometry/rays before moving into package. Staging removed after success.
validation.tags: Central runner supplies noasm; CGO_ENABLED=0 for all tests/build/vet/benchmarks.
validation.numeric: 48 geometry configurations across eight directions (including +/-Z and near-axis) and scales1e-5,1,1e10; independent parameter-domain coordinates/normals/UVs, polygon volume, winding, closed edge incidence/Euler2. Exact endpoints and hard-split ring copies. Inclusive maximum counts, NaN/Inf/MaxInt/short/out-of-bounds/unrepresentable final ring and annular gap.

pixels.coverage: Both meshes and projections, nonuniform/reflected TRS, near/far/side clipping, opaque/alpha/bilinear UV alpha with three colored point lights
pixels.oracle: Separate analytic parametric geometry/cross-product basis, Rodrigues/inverse-scale normal transform, independent Moller-Trumbore rays/camera/clipping/texture/lighting/composition; does not read production Mesh/builder.

validation.concurrency: Eight concurrent constructors/readers; independent storage; triangle and instance order byte-identical.
validation.budgets: Explicit constructor bounds/resolution failures; existing aggregate frame geometry/transparent fragment/point-light work errors; fragment/light error recovery renders succeed.
validation.legacy: 15 preexisting production three source hashes unchanged; existing Cylinder/Cone/Box and legacy pixel tests pass.

artifacts.result: pass,0.283s; final source image visually inspected
artifacts.layout: 2 columns cylinder/arrow,3 rows opaque/rotated reflected texture alpha with point lights/independent expected,240x180 per panel SSAA2
